title: Faucet battery pack needs replacement
shortDescription: U by Moen or MotionSense battery pack voltage has dropped below threshold.
fullDescription:
Moen smart faucets operate from a 6-AA battery pack (or optional AC adapter). When voltage drops, sensor response becomes sluggish and an LED at the faucet base blinks red.

Replace all six batteries with fresh alkaline cells. Do not mix brands or reuse partially depleted cells.

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Open control box under sink and install 6 fresh AA alkaline cells.

faq.a: Moen recommends alkaline only — NiMH voltage may be too low.

title: Capacitive touch activation not working
shortDescription: Tapping the faucet body no longer toggles water flow.
fullDescription:
Moen MotionSense Wave faucets use a capacitive sensor in the spout that responds to a tap. If the faucet is grounded to metallic plumbing via a sink clip that is loose, or the control box ground wire is disconnected, touch will not register.

Verify the green ground wire from the control box is attached to the metal faucet shank and secure.
symptoms: Motion works but touch does not

fixSteps.title: Check ground
fixSteps.instruction: Under sink, ensure green ground wire is firmly attached to the faucet shank.

videoSearchQuery: Moen MotionSense Wave touch not working

faq.q: Does this work with plastic pipes?
faq.a: Yes, but the ground clip must be routed to a grounded metal surface.

title: Alexa or Google voice commands not dispensing water
shortDescription: U by Moen is not responding to connected voice assistant commands.
fullDescription:
U by Moen exposes the faucet to Alexa and Google Home via cloud integration. If the integration is unlinked or the device is offline, voice commands fail silently.

Re-link the U by Moen skill in Alexa or Google Home and confirm the faucet shows Online in the U by Moen app.
symptoms: Alexa says it cannot reach device

fixSteps.title: Verify online
fixSteps.instruction: Open U by Moen app and confirm faucet shows connected.

fixSteps.title: Re-link skill
fixSteps.instruction: In Alexa or Google Home, disable and re-enable the U by Moen skill.

title: U by Moen offline in app
fullDescription: U by Moen connects via 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Router changes, SSID renames, or combined-band routers commonly break the link. Re-onboard through the U by Moen app.

fixSteps.title: Re-add faucet
fixSteps.instruction: In app, remove device and follow setup to re-onboard on 2.4 GHz.

faq.a: Yes, manual handle and motion still function.

title: Faucet turning on without user intent
shortDescription: MotionSense wave sensor is triggering on reflections or moving objects.
fullDescription: MotionSense uses two IR sensors — one at the base and one at the spout top. Reflective surfaces, steam, or a moving curtain can trigger false activations. Verify no shiny pots are left under the spout overnight and keep the sensor windows clean.

fixSteps.title: Clear sink
fixSteps.instruction: Remove shiny pots from under spout.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the two IR lenses with a soft cloth.

videoSearchQuery: Moen MotionSense turns on by itself

faq.a: Yes, hold the sensor 6 seconds until LED changes.

title: U by Moen delivering wrong temperature
shortDescription: Faucet delivers different temperature than preset requested.
fullDescription: U by Moen uses a motorized mixing valve. If the calibration between user app setting and valve position drifts, re-run the temperature calibration in the app's device settings to synchronize valve endpoints with hot and cold supply temperatures.

fixSteps.title: Calibrate
fixSteps.instruction: In U by Moen app, run Temperature Calibration under device settings.

faq.a: At least 120 F hot to reach warm presets.

title: Reduced water output
shortDescription: Flow rate dropped below expected output.
fullDescription: Moen smart faucets include an aerator and an inline filter screen at each supply connection. Sediment buildup is the most common cause of low flow. Clean aerator and inspect supply-line screens.

fixSteps.title: Clean aerator
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew aerator and rinse or replace.

fixSteps.title: Check supply screens
fixSteps.instruction: Shut water, disconnect supply hoses under sink, clean inline screens.

whenToCallPro: If flow remains low after cleaning.

title: Spout continues dripping after shutoff
shortDescription: Electronic valve not fully closing after use.
fullDescription: A small amount of residual drip is normal for a few seconds after shutoff. Continuous dripping indicates debris in the motorized valve or a worn cartridge. Clean supply filters first; if leak persists, the valve cartridge may need replacement.

fixSteps.title: Flush system
fixSteps.instruction: Run faucet fully open several times to flush debris.

fixSteps.title: Replace cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Per Moen service manual — shut water, disassemble handle, swap valve cartridge.

faq.a: Moen limited lifetime warranty covers cartridge for original owner.
